items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) on ETR Sunday injury board, corroborated by multiple reports. Eagles also without DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week; official final report.
items.implication: Major RB downgrade for PHI; expect committee or backup lead.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining PHI RBs and more Hurts rushing/passing volume.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday (ankle). Rapoport and others confirm he will not play vs ATL.
items.why: Left ankle injury; missed practices; ruled out Friday.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Huntley likely starts.
items.opportunity: Potential volume bump for Zay Flowers and other pass-catchers in altered scheme, though efficiency risk.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) alongside Barkley and Hollywood Brown for Eagles Week 5.
items.why: Hamstring; did not practice; final report OUT.
items.implication: PHI WR corps thinned; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs/TEs like Goedert (who is IN).

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN and expected to play/return for Commanders Week 5.
items.why: Elbow; upgraded, full participant, coach confirmation.
items.implication: WAS offense upgrade with starting QB back.
items.opportunity: Full QB1 rushing + passing volume restored; lifts all WAS skill players.

items.text: Broncos placed WR Pat Bryant on IR (ankle); promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey. Rapoport notes short-term IR, eligible to return Week ~9.
items.why: Ankle injury from prior game; short-term IR.
items.implication: DEN WR depth change for next 4 games.
items.opportunity: Target bump for remaining Broncos WRs like Waddle/Sutton.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Jets Week 5.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead role opens.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring) for Commanders; Daniels is IN.
items.implication: WAS WR targets open with Daniels returning.
items.opportunity: More routes/targets for McLaurin (Q) and other WAS pass-catchers.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (not on final injury report) after ankle maintenance/limited practice.
items.why: Ankle maintenance but cleared; full-go comments.
items.implication: Expected to play with potential expanded role.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry share expected vs prior week.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much better role/workload this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage criticism. Not on final IR.
items.why: Fan/media drag on Week 4 usage may force more work; cleared; gut says better role while accounting for downside.
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play with clear lead over backup.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries, snaps, and goal-line work expected.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt and James).
items.implication: LAC WR depth thinned; McConkey also Q.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for remaining Chargers WRs/TEs if McConkey limited.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN; ranks him WR8. Strong volume including red zone vs weak WR defense.
items.why: Target hog + red-zone work + Titans secondary struggles.
items.opportunity: High target/route share and RZ opportunities in favorable matchup.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/fantasy point gobbling. Benefits if Bengals WRs limited.
items.why: Workload + matchup vs MIA + potential WR injury boost to checkdowns.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share, especially if Chase/Higgins limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk stack long-term: sore knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, and coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) style. Frustration over second-half targets noted. Still good short-term but braced for messiness.
items.why: Knee + shoulder + QB/coaching risks compound; expressed target frustration.
items.implication: Monitor closely; high upside but volatility/ROS concern.
items.opportunity: Still high target share when healthy, but injury/usage risk elevated.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10 due to volume and red-zone work vs vulnerable secondary.
items.why: Target volume + RZ + DET pass defense issues.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets in positive game script potential.
